entities.name: Gothic Cathedrals (Notre-Dame, Chartres)
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Ribbed vaults, pointed arches, and flying buttresses allowed walls to be replaced by stained glass. Notre-Dame de Paris (1163), Chartres (1194), Amiens (1220). Soaring interior heights of 42m+.
